faqs.question: Can we change the colours or the theme?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us the theme and colours when you book and we will match them at no extra cost, as long as the material count stays the same.

faqs.question: How much space does a setup need?
faqs.answer: A ring or wall setup needs about 8 ft of clear wall and 4 ft of depth. Full stage setups need 14 to 16 ft of width. Send us a photo of your space and we will confirm.
